teaser.en: A 'little sisal' that is really an arum, sending its leaves straight up from a buried rhizome.
teaser.sw: 'Mkonge mdogo' ambao kwa kweli ni wa familia ya majimbi, unaochipua majani yake moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) kilichozikwa.

summary.en: *Chikonje* is a small arum whose leaves rise straight from the ground. Digo named it after sisal, which it resembles in a small way.
summary.sw: *Chikonje* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya majimbi ambao majani yake huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka ardhini. Wadigo waliupa jina la mkonge, ambao unafanana nao kwa udogo.

about.en: *Stylochaeton salaamicus* is a perennial herb of the arum family. It grows from an underground rhizome, and its arrow-shaped leaves come straight up out of the soil on long stalks. Its flowers are packed onto a short spike inside a hooded spathe that sits at or just below ground level, often hidden among the leaf bases.
about.sw: *Stylochaeton salaamicus* ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu wa familia ya majimbi. Huota kutoka kwenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi), na majani yake ya umbo la mshale huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka udongoni juu ya vikonyo virefu. Maua yake yamesongamana kwenye kishada kifupi ndani ya ganda la ua lenye umbo la kofia (spathe) lililo kwenye usawa wa ardhi au chini kidogo yake, mara nyingi likiwa limejificha kati ya vitako vya majani.

where.en: It is found in Kenya and Tanzania, in coastal bush and thicket.
where.sw: Unapatikana nchini Kenya na Tanzania, katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani.

names.en: *Chikonje* means 'small sisal'. Pakia explains that the plant resembles *konje*, sisal (*Agave sisalana*), and the prefix *chi-* marks its smaller size. He also records a second name, *nyaa*, which he writes *chinyaa* in his naming notes, and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. Another plant named after sisal is *konje tsaka*, 'forest sisal' (*Sansevieria kirkii*).
names.sw: *Chikonje* maana yake ni 'mkonge mdogo'. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mmea huu unafanana na *konje*, mkonge (*Agave sisalana*), na kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wake. Pia ameandika jina la pili, *nyaa*, ambalo katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina analiandika *chinyaa*, na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina la mkonge ni *konje tsaka*, 'mkonge wa msituni' (*Sansevieria kirkii*).

reason.en: Sansevieria, another plant compared to sisal
reason.sw: Sansevieria, mmea mwingine unaofananishwa na mkonge

reason.en: Gonatopus, another member of the arum family
reason.sw: Gonatopus, mmea mwingine wa familia ya majimbi

reason.en: Bulb plant of the coastal forest floor
reason.sw: Mmea wa tunguu wa sakafu ya msitu wa pwani
Mshubiri, mmea mwingine wenye shada la majani usawa wa ardhi
